description: Five identically-named 'Daek' activities at the same location in the old revision, six in the new (one added). ID column is a bare positional 'Id' (not durable), so identity for this group can only come from the name+location+date-order matching path (nusf_compare_engine._resolve_activity_matches greedy nearest-date pairing within a name+location group).
notes: All 5 old rows pair with 5 of the 6 new rows by ascending (start, finish) date-distance within the group; the 6th new row (genuinely new, latest dates) is reported as added rather than colliding with a leftover old row. added==['Daek'] and removed==[] together are the pass/fail signal here -- a regression in the grouped-matching logic would either wrongly report removed activities or silently mis-pair two unrelated 'Daek' rows.
